Scalar elimination does not equate conformal and multiplicative matter actions.

M_LATTICE_U1_2D_TOY.group_and_geometry: Finite cyclic subgroup mu_f ~= Z_f subset U(1) on simply connected 2D box Lambda_n in Z^2 (tower maps require n_j <= n_{j+1} and f_j | f_{j+1})
M_LATTICE_U1_2D_TOY.relation_to_nov_su2_4d: Distinct group (abelian Z_f vs compact SU(2)), topology (open 2D box vs periodic 4D torus (Z/lZ)^4), field content (pure links vs coupled U, psi, rho_t), action, measure, and readout. Diagonal embedding z -> diag(z, z^-1) suffers an irreversible Stage-1 global SU(2) Weyl-conjugation gauge quotient (256 -> 136 at f=4, which no gauge-invariant Wilson loop or gauge choice can undo) followed by Stage-2 single-plaquette trace loss (136 -> 81, bijectively recovered up to all 136 Weyl classes by larger multi-plaquette Wilson loops). At fixed B, recovery requires a growing detector footprint: logarithmic m_j under growing K_1(j) = m_j with full word realizability, or polynomial m_j with fixed K_1 when 1 + gamma < 2 K_1 (automatic under Theorem 10's K_1, eventually impossible when 1 + gamma > 2 K_1).

clock_and_observable_dictionary.underlying_field_perturbation: r = delta_rho_t / rho_0 (dimensionless fractional temporal-density perturbation)
clock_and_observable_dictionary.local_intrinsic_clock_response: alpha_rho, defined by y_clock_int = alpha_rho * r at fixed local metric
clock_and_observable_dictionary.gravitational_transfer: T_grav (mathcal{T}), defined by r = T_grav * p where p = Delta_Phi / c^2
clock_and_observable_dictionary.total_vs_anomalous_redshift_slope: Total observed gravitational redshift slope d ln(nu)/d(Phi/c^2) = 1 + delta_alpha_Phi, where 1 is the standard GR metric redshift and delta_alpha_Phi = alpha_rho * T_grav is the anomalous (non-metric, SIT-additional) fractional redshift slope (T_grav enters strictly once).
clock_and_observable_dictionary.event_count_vs_atomic_clock: Event rate N(tau)/tau (Paper 007 point-process estimator) and fractional atomic frequency shift Delta_nu/nu are distinct operational observables requiring an explicit calibrated detector/transduction model to relate.
